name: io.github.beepboop2025/seiche
title: Seiche — funding-stress terminal
description: Funding stress early warning for US money markets from free public data, with a construction-PIT historical diagnostic, explicit eligibility flags, and bounded oil/FX/material cash-pressure context.

environmentVariables.name: SEICHE_MCP_PUBLIC
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to expose only the eight free public tools over stdio: funding_stress_now, historical_analogs, proof_backtest, data_health, crypto_stress_record, institutional_flows, oil_funding_context, fx_materials_passage. The hosted endpoint gives an anonymous caller the same eight with no token.
